title: Gate agent merges with evaluations
subtitle: Pack PR source, import to CI, evaluate the draft, and block merge below the pass threshold.

steps.title: Pack the PR source
steps.evidence: EvalGateADO packs the PR branch's src folder into an unmanaged solution

steps.title: Import into CI environment
steps.evidence: then imports it into a dedicated CI Dev environment.

steps.title: Evaluate the draft agent
steps.evidence: The Evaluation API triggers runs against draft Copilot Studio agents, polls completion, and returns metric-level results for each test case.

steps.title: Block merge on low pass rate
steps.evidence: The pipeline compares passed tests with a configurable pass threshold and exits unsuccessfully when the rate is lower, blocking the merge.
